changelog:
Initial release of vvvv-patching skill.

- Explains vvvv gamma visual programming patterns, including dataflow, node connections, and regions (ForEach, If, Switch, Repeat, Accumulator).
- Covers reactive data flow with Channels, event handling (Bang, Toggle, FrameDelay, Changed), and patch organization best practices.
- Describes when to use patching versus C# coding.
- Highlights common anti-patterns like circular dependencies, excessive nodes, polling vs. reacting, and handling Nil spreads.
- Includes recommendations on naming conventions and patch structuring.
summary: Explains vvvv gamma visual programming patterns — dataflow, node connections, regions (ForEach/If/Switch/Repeat/Accumulator), channels for reactive data flow...
